## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2018-05-07: Form-of TRA filed as Ex 10.1 to S-1/A (unexecuted)
- 2018-05-25: Up-C IPO closes; TRA executed by EVO Payments, EVO Investco LLC, and the Continuing LLC Owners (Blueapple, MDP affiliates)
- 2018-08-10: Executed TRA filed as Ex 10.1 to Q2 2018 10-Q

#### Global Payments merger and termination amendment

- 2022-08-01: Amendment No. 1 signed concurrently with Global Payments merger agreement; converts TRA into a $225M aggregate Final TRA Payment due at merger close and provides for automatic termination thereafter
- 2022-08-02: Amendment No. 1 filed as Ex 10.4 to merger announcement 8-K
- 2022-09-22: DEFM14A discloses the $225M aggregate cap (per-recipient Annex A redacted)
- 2023-03-24: Falcon Merger Sub / Global Payments merger closes; Final TRA Payments triggered and TRA terminates automatically under Section 2 of Amendment No. 1

## Explanation

EVO Payments entered into its Tax Receivable Agreement at the May 25, 2018 Up-C IPO close, paying 85% of cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups on exchanges of EVO Investco LLC Interests (paired with Class C/D Common Stock) plus pre-IPO favorable tax attributes available to the Company from the Reorganization Transactions; principal beneficiaries were Blueapple, Inc. and Madison Dearborn Capital Partners VI affiliates. The TRA carried a balance of roughly $180-183M through 2021 and 2022. On August 1, 2022, concurrently with the Global Payments merger agreement, EVO and the TRA Payment Recipients signed Amendment No. 1 converting the TRA into a fixed-cap obligation: at merger Effective Time EVO would pay a $225M aggregate Final TRA Payment (about $97M below the approximately $322M that would have been payable under the unamended Early Termination Payment formula) and the TRA would terminate automatically with full releases. The Falcon Merger Sub / Global Payments merger closed March 24, 2023, triggering the Final TRA Payments and automatic termination per Section 2 of Amendment No. 1; per-recipient Annex A amounts remain redacted in the publicly filed exhibit. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record and the deferred-CSV reconciliation note.
